title: Mid-Level Data Engineer
description: Mid-level data engineering position focused on building scalable, production-grade ETL/ELT pipelines, distributed data processing with PySpark, dimensional data warehousing, ACID Lakehouse formats, Kafka streaming, and robust DataOps practices.

skills.rationale: Mastery of database indexing, table partitioning, transactions, and execution plan optimization.
Writing high-concurrency, functional, type-safe Python/Scala data processing services.
Developing and tuning Spark jobs, partition management, broadcast joins, and caching.
Architecting Snowflake/BigQuery warehouses, clustering, and managing complex SCD Type 2 logic.
Designing robust idempotent Airflow/Prefect pipelines, handling backfills, and managing SLAs.
Authoring enterprise dbt incremental models, reusable Jinja macros, and custom tests.
Operating Delta Lake / Iceberg tables, managing time travel, and Z-Order optimization.
Building Kafka Streams / ksqlDB pipelines and handling event time windowing.
Provisioning data infrastructure with Terraform, IAM security, and automated CI/CD.
Implementing OpenLineage metadata, DataHub catalogs, and PII anonymization policies.

scoring.description: Each skill score is multiplied by its importance weight. Final score is the sum of weighted scores divided by sum of weights.

not_ready.description: Lacks production experience with distributed processing and Lakehouse table formats.

partially_ready.description: Competent in batch ETL but requires guidance on Spark tuning and streaming architectures.

ready.description: Fully autonomous data engineer capable of delivering reliable enterprise data pipelines and optimizing cloud compute.

exceeds.description: Demonstrates senior-level technical leadership, distributed internals mastery, and architectural vision.
